app.title: Document Agent
app.title.tip: Ask questions about your PDF documents. Answers are generated only from the documents you upload.
app.tab.chat.tip: Talk to the agent and see how it found each answer
app.tab.documents.tip: Upload, preview and delete the PDFs the agent searches
chat.input.tip: Type a question. Enter sends it, Shift+Enter adds a new line.
chat.send.tip: Send the question to the agent
chat.thinking.tip: The agent is searching the documents and writing an answer
chat.clear.tip: Start a new conversation. The current one is discarded.
chat.answer.tip: The agent's answer, based only on the passages shown under details
settings.open.tip: Change how the agent searches. Applies to the next question.
settings.title: Agent settings
settings.mode.label: Search mode
settings.mode.tip: How passages are found for the agent
settings.mode.hybrid.tip: Keyword and semantic search combined. Best default.
settings.mode.bm25.tip: Keyword search. Finds exact terms such as drug names and doses.
settings.mode.vector.tip: Semantic search with embeddings. Finds paraphrases and synonyms.
settings.topK.label: Passages per search
settings.topK.tip: How many passages each search returns to the agent (1–{max}). More gives more context but a longer prompt.
settings.maxSteps.label: Max steps
settings.maxSteps.tip: How many times the agent may call tools before it must answer (1–{max})
turn.mode.tip: Search mode used for this answer
turn.topK.tip: Passages per search used for this answer
turn.steps.tip: Number of tool calls the agent made
turn.duration.tip: Time the agent took to answer
turn.details.tip: Show every tool call the agent made, with its arguments and results
step.auto.tip: Runs before the model sees the question: always searches for the question as typed
step.list_documents.tip: The agent listed the uploaded documents
step.read_page.tip: The agent read a whole page
step.unknown.tip: The agent asked for a tool that does not exist
step.args.tip: Arguments the agent passed to the tool
step.error.tip: The tool failed and the error was passed back to the agent
step.noHits.tip: The search returned nothing for these arguments
step.output.tip: Text the tool returned to the agent
hit.tip: Passage the agent received from {filename}, page {page}
hit.score.tip: Relevance score. Its scale depends on the search mode: BM25 has no upper limit, vector is cosine similarity, hybrid is a rank-fusion score up to about 0.033.
documents.upload.tip: Upload one or more PDFs. Text is extracted, scanned pages are read with OCR, then the document is indexed for search.
documents.column.file.tip: Click a file name to preview it
documents.column.status.tip: Whether the document can be searched yet
documents.column.pages.tip: Page count, and how many pages were read with OCR
documents.open.tip: Preview the original PDF and the text extracted from it
documents.ocrPages.tip: {count, plural, one {# page has} other {# pages have}} no text layer and {count, plural, one {was} other {were}} read with OCR. Check them for recognition errors.
documents.delete.tip: Delete {filename} with all its pages and passages. This cannot be undone.
documents.status.processing.tip: Extracting text, running OCR and indexing. The document is not searchable yet.
documents.status.ready.tip: Indexed and used by the agent
preview.tab.pdf.tip: The uploaded PDF as it is
preview.tab.pdf.missing.tip: The original file is not stored for this document. It was uploaded before files were kept.
preview.tab.text.tip: The text the agent searches, page by page
preview.ocr.tip: This page had no text layer. The text was recognised from the image and may contain errors.
preview.frame.title: PDF preview of {filename}
